rows.summary: Autonomous systems increasingly utilize multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) to pursue self-generated goals. Recent developments, specifically Pareto-Conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PC-PPO), provide mechanisms to learn non-dominated policy portfolios, allowing navigation of reliability-efficiency frontiers without retraining. While these advancements mitigate rigid reward scalarization, the field still faces fundamental challenges regarding non-convex optimization and long-term goal prioritization.
